Perfect! I've successfully created and activated a draggable notes component. The component allows you to:

1. **Click and drag** any of the three notes (Weekend ideas, Reading list, Garden notes) around the workspace
2. **Visual feedback** - when dragging, the note gets a light blue background and a "grabbing" cursor with a stronger shadow
3. **Persistent positions** - when you release the note, its new position is saved to the desk

The component reads the current positions from the desk scene and displays all three notes as draggable cards. You can now click and drag them around freely!
